video_title: Steph Curry, Draymond Green, Coach Steve Kerr | Warriors Interviews x Highlights vs Clippers

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on the Warriors' preseason learning curve and execution
quotes.excerpt: It is hard to assess when you are playing six-minute stretches and this is about reps, film, getting in shape.
quotes.quote: It is hard to assess when you are playing six-minute stretches and this is about reps, film, getting in shape, and increasing the expectations on execution every preseason game we have.

quotes.speaker: Steph Curry
quotes.summary_phrase: Steph Curry on Brandon Podziemski's aggressive playstyle and development
quotes.excerpt: The balance for a young guy who is expected to have an impact is to walk that fine line of aggressiveness.
quotes.quote: The balance for a young guy who is expected to have an impact is to walk that fine line of aggressiveness but being okay knowing you are going to make mistakes and not getting deflated, being able to move on to the next play. We do not want anything passive, and I think he has been answering that call early.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the Warriors' preseason shooting and spacing issues
quotes.excerpt: Spacing was not great, Tom. Three or four plays in the first half where we did not get the corners filled.
quotes.quote: Spacing was not great, Tom. Three or four plays in the first half where we did not get the corners filled and we did some random stuff and got into some tough situations and that caused some turnovers, so spacing, flow, all that stuff has to improve.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Brandon Podziemski's need for aggressive scoring mentality
quotes.excerpt: We need Brandon Podziemski to have an aggressive scoring mentality and that is something we are going to work with him on.
quotes.quote: We need Brandon Podziemski to have an aggressive scoring mentality and that is something we are going to work with him on because he can make plays and he can score. He is a really good player, but he has got to get comfortable with the NBA game and with his opponents' personnel.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Brandon Podziemski's transition speed and offensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: The on-ball speed and ability to get transition hoops and get to the rim and pick and roll at that pace.
quotes.quote: The on-ball speed and ability to get transition hoops and get to the rim and pick and roll at that pace, he is a real weapon and we are lucky to have him.
